display_name: Ten recorded defects in the cross-references of the Privacy Protection Law, 5741-1981, as amended by Amendment 13, and of five sets of regulations made under it, as typed values with their tests: the First Schedule's citation of the repealed s 7, the Third Schedule's use of a person the Law no longer names, the 1986, 1981 and 2001 regulations' use of repealed or replaced terms, the 2023 regulations' reliance on the repealed s 7, the 2004 schedule's listing of repealed ss 31א and 17א, and the rounding rule against the per-person rates; with seven sound controls; not an encoding of the Law
domain_expert_review: none: no domain expert has read this against the source
seat: the individual to whom the Law is applied: the individual about whom personal information is held in a database. The row asks no question from the seat because it records references.

source.deposit_kind: excerpt: the lines a citation of this row needs; the file header gives the original line numbers

read_in_place.note: read from its own subject and not copied; the revision was not matched again here

source.note: every consolidation above is unofficial; a reading is CONSOLIDATION-ONLY unless NOTES.md says it was read from a page image of the instrument. The official pages read are in amending-laws/ and official/ with their page images.
source.page_extracts_note: the official PDFs hold only the pages the row reads (page extracts of the whole files, whose sha256 are in SOURCES.json); SH 3287 pp. 1438 and 1474 are cropped images, with no PDF page

expected_red.note: two assertions for each of ten defects, each stating what the citing words or the rounding rule need. Nine are citations: the First Schedule item 4(א) to s 7 (P1), the Third Schedule definition paragraph (3) to בעל מאגר (P2), regulation 1 of the 1986 regulations to s 7 and to s 12 (P3), the 1981 inspection regulations to הרשם (P4), regulation 7 of the 2023 regulations to s 7 (P5), the 2001 regulations to בעל מאגר (P7) and the 2004 schedule to ss 31א and 17א (P8, two defects). The tenth is the rounding rule of s 23לב(ב) against the rates the notice of 7 October 2026 prints for 2 and for 4 shekels (P6). The failing assertions follow the LITERAL reading; the readings through s 25 of the Interpretation Law (P3(b), P5) and the historical-text reading of P1 are recorded in NOTES.md, and the s 25 readings as green tests

run.method: one Sonnet builder, from a written brief; the page images of the official pages were read by the builder
